purpose: Source-labelled comparisons and uncertainty; not a replacement gun table or historical-fidelity certification.

ttt17.title: US Military Intelligence Service, Tactical and Technical Trends No. 17, 28 January 1943
ttt17.pages: Printed pp. 11 (scope), 14 (88-mm table); PDF pages 15 and 18, respectively, one based
ttt17.source_kind: Inspected facsimile of a primary wartime intelligence publication
ttt17.scope: Introduction says performance generally based on trials in England; estimated figures marked; homogeneous armor. 88-mm multipurpose gun APCBC row states muzzle velocity 2750 ft/s and projectile weight 21 lb.
ttt17.criterion: Penetration probability, complete-perforation criterion, target hardness, shell mark and lot are not specified in the inspected table.
ttt17.identity_warning: 838.2 m/s and 9.52543977 kg differ from the live Tiger PzGr.39 entry, 773 m/s and 10.2 kg. Do not fit the live entry to these rows as if ammunition identity were established.

kv_trial.title: KV-1 and T-34 firing report, Table 2, archival citation TsAMO RF fond 38, opis 11355, delo 1545, sheets 9-10 supplied by scan host
kv_trial.pages: Visible printed page 9, Table 2; companion printed page 10 photographs
kv_trial.source_kind: Inspected image of primary report; archival identifier from host, not independently checked against archive catalogue
kv_trial.criterion: Individual observed damage, not a population ballistic limit. The page states KV-1 firing distance 1500 m; AP shell mark, velocity, lot, hardness and exact compound strike geometry are not established.
kv_trial.angle_warning: Preserve raw constructive-angle and encounter-angle columns. Treating 70 degrees encounter as 20 degrees from normal is a conditional interpretation; do not compound it with the constructive angle again without a verified convention.

t34_crop.title: T-34 damage table crop reproduced on IL-2 forum
t34_crop.pages: No page number, date or range visible in the inspected crop
t34_crop.source_kind: Inspected primary-looking table image, incomplete chain of provenance; forum narrative is not primary evidence
t34_crop.criterion: Individual damage descriptions. Front plate entry includes breach, driver hatch torn, cracks and shell ricochet; nose entry records a through hole. Cannot equate these to an all-front-plate perforation probability.
t34_crop.reason: Full parent report, page, distance, shell identity and angle convention are not verified. Excluded from numeric comparison and parameter fitting.

primary_event_observations.observed: 20 mm deep dent; projectile ricocheted into the left corner of the frontal plate screen and chipped it
primary_event_observations.comparison: Geometry-sensitive ricochet. Binary effective-thickness solver has no explicit ricochet law; do not calibrate from a guessed clean-plate angle.

primary_event_observations.observed: Through perforation; entrance 120 by 110 mm, exit 190 by 130 mm
primary_event_observations.comparison: Conditional representative-plate sensitivity only at 20 and 70 degrees; neither interpretation establishes ammunition equivalence.

primary_event_observations.observed: Through perforation of screen and underlying plate, with cracking
primary_event_observations.comparison: Excluded from monolithic 105 mm calibration; layout, sequence and prior damage matter.

quarantined_t34_observations.observed: Breach, driver hatch torn off, cracks 160-170 mm, shell ricochet
Through hole 160 by 90 mm with cracks and weld damage

secondary_candidates_not_calibration.reason: User-supplied compilation lacks per-number primary citations and criterion; no blanket Soviet/German conversion accepted.

doctrine_not_calibration.reason: Tactical engagement diagrams encode doctrine and conditions; they are not ballistic-limit curves. Individual chart digits were not verified in this pass.
